title: V-WorkForce
tagline: V-WorkForce is a decentralized AI-powered workforce marketplace, enabling users to buy, rent, or deploy AI agents for legal, finance, and HR tasks. Powered by Coinbase AgentKit, Privy, Nillion SecretVault & OpSec, it ensures secure, trustless, and on-chain AI services.
description:
V-WorkForce is a decentralized, AI-powered workforce marketplace designed to revolutionize how individuals and businesses access professional services. By leveraging advanced AI agents, the platform enables users to buy, rent, or deploy specialized agents that automate complex workflows efficiently.

Key Features:

AI Legal Consultant: This agent addresses client inquiries, offers case analyses, and recommends legal strategies, ensuring timely and accurate legal advice.

AI Contract Drafting & Review Agent: Specialized in drafting, analyzing, and securely storing legal contracts, this agent streamlines the contract management process, reducing manual effort and minimizing errors.

Technical Integrations:

Coinbase AgentKit: Facilitates seamless cryptocurrency transactions within the platform, ensuring secure and efficient payments.

Privy: Provides user-friendly authentication mechanisms, enhancing platform security and user experience.

Nillion SecretVault: Offers encrypted storage solutions for contracts, ensuring data confidentiality and integrity.

OpSec: Enables fully decentralized hosting, promoting a trustless and secure environment for AI services with on-chain execution.

Future Expansion:

V-WorkForce aims to broaden its suite of AI agents to encompass various sectors, including finance, human resources, healthcare, and more. This expansion will contribute to building a global, AI-driven professional workforce, providing specialized agents tailored to diverse industry needs.

Compliance with ETHGlobal Agentic Ethereum Hackathon Requirements:

In alignment with the ETHGlobal Agentic Ethereum Hackathon guidelines, V-WorkForce has been developed to meet the following criteria:

Integration of AI Agents: The platform showcases innovative use cases of AI agents, particularly in the legal domain, by offering services such as legal consultation and contract management.

Decentralized Application Development: V-WorkForce is built as a decentralized application (dApp), ensuring that its services operate on a trustless and secure infrastructure.

Utilization of Partner Technologies: The platform integrates with partner technologies like Coinbase AgentKit and Nillion SecretVault, aligning with the hackathon's emphasis on collaborative development.

Open Source Contribution: The project's codebase is maintained in an open-source repository, promoting transparency and community engagement.

By adhering to these requirements, V-WorkForce not only aligns with the hackathon's objectives but also sets a foundation for future innovations in decentralized AI-driven professional services.
how_its_made:
V-WorkForce was built as a decentralized AI-powered workforce marketplace that seamlessly integrates AI, blockchain, and decentralized storage technologies to provide professional AI services. Here's a breakdown of how we built it and the key components involved:

Tech Stack & Architecture
V-WorkForce consists of three major components running independently:

1️⃣ Frontend (Client)

Tech Used: Next.js (React.js), Tailwind CSS
Purpose: Provides a user-friendly interface for browsing AI agents, making payments, and managing contracts.
Key Features:
Wallet-based authentication with Privy.
AI agent marketplace for easy selection.
Secure transaction processing using Coinbase AgentKit.
2️⃣ Agent Service (Backend)

Tech Used: Node.js, Express.js, OpenAI API, Coinbase AgentKit
Purpose: Manages AI-powered legal agents, including consultation, contract drafting, and compliance checks.
Key Features:
AI-powered legal consultation & compliance checks using OpenAI's GPT-4 API.
Secure contract drafting and validation.
AI-to-AI transaction handling using Coinbase AgentKit.
3️⃣ SecretVault Service (Backend)

Tech Used: Node.js, Express.js, Nillion SecretVault
Purpose: Provides decentralized encrypted storage for legal contracts.
Key Features:
Secure contract storage & retrieval using Nillion SecretVault.
On-chain document verification to ensure trustless storage.
4️⃣ Blockchain & Payments

Network: Ethereum (Base Sepolia Testnet)
Smart Contracts: Solidity-based payments & AI agent deployment contracts.
Wallet Integration: MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet
Partner Technology Integrations & Their Benefits
Coinbase AgentKit (Onchain Payments & AI Wallets)

Enables seamless payments for AI agents using Base Sepolia ETH.
Supports agent-to-agent transactions for decentralized workforce automation.
Privy (Wallet Abstraction & Authentication)

Allows easy authentication via wallets, making the platform secure & frictionless.
Users log in with their Web3 wallets and access AI services instantly.
Nillion SecretVault (Secure Decentralized Storage)

Ensures that legal contracts and AI-generated documents are encrypted and trustlessly stored.
Eliminates centralized control over sensitive legal data.
OpSec (Decentralized Hosting)

Provides censorship-resistant infrastructure for running the AI marketplace.
Ensures high uptime & data integrity.
Hacky & Notable Implementations
🚀 AI-to-AI Payments:

Implemented automated agent-to-agent transactions where AI agents can receive and send funds autonomously.
🔐 Self-Sovereign Data Storage:

Contracts never touch centralized databases, ensuring full decentralization.
⚖️ AI Compliance Validation:

Integrated an AI-driven compliance officer that checks documents against GDPR, SEC, and other regulations.
⏳ Optimized Transaction Costs:

By leveraging Base Sepolia, we reduced gas fees while ensuring on-chain execution.
